name: @kitsuden/mcp-server
description: Kitsuden Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for AI agents. Runs on Bun.

scripts.build: bun build ./src/index.ts --outdir ./dist --target=bun && bun build ./src/standalone.ts --outdir ./dist --target=bun && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir dist
scripts.prepublishOnly: pnpm -w run test:unit tests/unit/mcp-domain-tools.test.ts tests/unit/mcp-explorer-params.test.ts tests/unit/mcp-sse-web.test.ts && node ../../scripts/release/dist-check.mjs --bun

author: Victor Antinori Broce (https://github.com/vigogami)
